name: m4-symfinal-symops
description: The candidate cut from [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199), final `Symbol` predicates, `info`, `rawInfo`, `owner`, `typeOfThis`, `tpe_*`, `mapOverType` and the `decls` fast path, against `2.13.x`. `SymbolOpsBenchmark`'s `all` workload: `findMember`, `overridingPairs`, `subst` × 16 and `erasure` × 5 per op, over the classes of a scala corpus compile done in setup. The weights are a choice, so the size of the total only compares within this workload.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, no profiler.
